title_zh: 社会服务与人际沟通 — 第16节
body_en: Good communication starts with clear purpose: what do you need the other person to know? Use short sentences. Check that they understood. In messages, tone is easy to miss — be polite and specific. Listening is half of every talk.
body_zh: 沟通先明确目的：你要对方知道什么？用短句。确认对方听懂了。消息里语气易被误读——礼貌且具体。倾听占谈话一半。
